e_cn.4_sr.189-0035.note: Cassin asks that para. 1 of article 8 (filling vacancies) be aligned with the amended election articles.

e_cn.4_sr.247-0072.note: Cassin accepts the Working Group text of article G, which draws ECOSOC's attention to the organs furnishing technical assistance.

e_cn.4_sr.258-0025.note: Mehta asks that 'and Trust Territories' be added to the US amendment on the self-determination article; some doubt whether the text is the article or the companion recommendations.

e_cn.4_sr.222-0043.note: Roosevelt accepts 'and' for 'including' (housing) in her standard-of-living proposal.

e_cn.4_sr.300-0042.note: Morozov asks for a roll-call on para. 8 of the USSR amendment, in the vote on the trade union article.

e_cn.4_sr.275-0038.note: Cassin on the text of article 20 (right to work) and the USSR, Chilean and Yugoslav amendments.

e_cn.4_sr.61-0046.note: Pavlov on the grounds of discrimination to list in articles 21-22 (the right to vote and elections).

e_cn.4_sr.194-0032.note: Nisot on troops abroad as being under the State's jurisdiction, i.e. the scope clause of art. 2(1).

e_cn.4_sr.197-0143.note: Cassin on the order of business: the French draft resolution on implementation should be considered first; nothing to do with the amendments article.

e_cn.4_sr.314-0041.note: Support for the Belgian motion to reconsider the vote on the Indian amendment ('as soon as may be') to the liberty article.

e_cn.4_sr.223-0048.note: Cassin asks for a vote in parts on the Egyptian (Chile-amended) proposal for the health article; this is the order and form of votes on its amendments.

e_cn.4_sr.258-0038.note: Cassin asks whether adopting the 'political status' clause of the US amendments would prejudge whether the self-determination article goes in one covenant or both.

e_cn.4_ac.1_sr.8-0012.note: Harry proposes merging the first four or five articles into an introduction, and the Chairman notes the deletion of articles 3/4; this is the structure of the opening articles, not article 1 (borderline).

e_cn.4_sr.385-0005.note: Whitlam explains his abstention on the marriage and family article (equality of spouses, para. 4), i.e. ICCPR art. 23, not art. 44.

e_cn.4_sr.188-0017.note: Cassin compares the Danish amendment with alternative A on how States nominate candidates.

e_cn.4_sr.194-0028.note: Nisot proposes wording on individuals subject to the State's jurisdiction within its territory or abroad (art. 2(1)).

e_cn.4_sr.258-0041.note: Roosevelt explains the separate vote on 'freely to determine their political status' and putting the article in both covenants.

e_cn.4_ac.1_sr.4-0105.note: Wilson supports article 45 (non-discrimination) but would refer the question to the competent Sub-Commission.

e_cn.4_sr.220-0048.note: Roosevelt withdraws the US proposal in favour of the Australian social security text.

e_cn.4_sr.61-0043.note: Chang accepts the Indian-UK wording of articles 21-22, and the US chair comments on its grounds of discrimination and first sentence.

e_cn.4_sr.189-0035.note: France on adjusting the first paragraph of the draft article on filling Committee vacancies to amendments made in other articles.

e_cn.4_sr.247-0072.note: France on the Working Group text of article 0 (ECOSOC bringing technical-assistance matters to other organs), which is the technical assistance article.

e_cn.4_sr.258-0025.note: India's conditions for withdrawing her draft in favour of the US amendment on self-determination (Trust Territories); wording of the self-determination article.

e_cn.4_sr.222-0043.note: US accepts replacing 'including' by 'and' housing in her proposal on the standard-of-living article.

e_cn.4_sr.300-0042.note: USSR asks a roll-call vote on paragraph 8 of its amendment to the trade-union article; vote on an amendment to that article.

e_cn.4_sr.275-0038.note: France on article 20 (right to work) and the USSR, Chilean and Yugoslav amendments to it.

e_cn.4_sr.61-0046.note: USSR on adding grounds (education, residence, plural votes) to the list of discrimination grounds in the articles on voting and elections (arts 21/22 of the draft); about the article's wording.

e_cn.4_sr.194-0032.note: Belgium on troops abroad being under a State's jurisdiction, in the debate on the 'territory and jurisdiction' wording of the obligations article.

e_cn.4_sr.197-0143.note: France says its draft resolution on implementation of the covenant should be taken first; order of business on draft resolutions, not the amendment article's text.

e_cn.4_sr.314-0041.note: US, UK and Lebanon support Belgium's motion to reconsider the vote on the Indian amendment ('as soon as may be') to the liberty and security article.

e_cn.4_sr.223-0048.note: France asks for separate votes on paragraphs of the Egyptian proposal on health; order and form of votes on amendments to the health article.

e_cn.4_sr.258-0038.note: France asks whether adopting a clause of the US self-determination amendment would prejudice placing the article in one or both covenants; concerns the self-determination article's wording and place (could be read as a general one-or-two-covenants question).

e_cn.4_ac.1_sr.8-0012.note: Australia suggests combining the first four or five articles into one introduction and the Chair clarifies the fate of article 4; about the structure of several opening articles, not article 1's text (borderline).

e_cn.4_sr.385-0005.note: Australia explains his abstention on the marriage and family article (paragraph 4 on equality of rights), not the relation-to-other-procedures article.

e_cn.4_sr.188-0017.note: France on the Danish amendment on nominations of Committee members, compared with alternative A.

e_cn.4_sr.194-0028.note: Belgium proposes wording 'subject to its jurisdiction, whether within its territory or abroad' for the obligations article.

e_cn.4_sr.258-0041.note: US explains why a separate vote was requested on the political-status wording of the self-determination amendment and how to split it between the covenants (about the article's text; also touches the one-or-two-covenants question).

e_cn.4_ac.1_sr.4-0105.note: UK supports the non-discrimination article (draft 45) but wants the question referred to the Sub-Commission; short intervention about that article.

e_cn.4_sr.220-0048.note: US withdraws her proposal in favour of the Australian text on the social security article.

e_cn.4_sr.61-0043.note: China withdraws his amendment; US on the text of the articles on political participation (grounds of discrimination, right to take part in government) and supports the Indian-UK draft.
